name: delegate-body-trigger-tap
description: On a phone-width viewport the two-level body trigger sometimes is the row's ONLY control (a summary-less delegate row, issue #1253) and must meet the --tap-min touch floor (tokens.css, decision 4), not be a bare 14px chevron. At 390px the trigger is at least 44x44, its center is owned by its own button, and the bare content line (.intentLine: rail icon, status dot, and intent as one flex item) still shares its first line - so the max-width reservation reserves the trigger's grown --tap-min width AND bounds the icon's full outer width, which below the 700px breakpoint is not cancelled by the .rowIcon negative-gutter pull (roborev).

mutation.note: Without the phone block the trigger measures the chevron's ~14px box in both axes, below the 44px tap floor.
